doc_bogue.phrase: This was the first time that they ever forced us under cover so we thought it might be the real thing

doc_torch.phrase: They first threw a lighted torch into the entrance and followed it with a bucket or two of gasoline

doc_smith.phrase: drums of gasoline were just over the fence a little way from them

doc_tenrule.phrase: providing for the execution of ten prisoners for each one that escaped

doc_nielsen.phrase: struck in the leg, head, and ribs by bullets, but nevertheless kept on swimming

doc_barta.phrase: although I saw no planes either then or later

doc_fishtrap.phrase: because of exhaustion had to remain on a fish trap all night

doc_planes.phrase: to remain under cover, the Japs saying that there were hundreds of American planes approaching

doc_bogue2.phrase: I concealed myself in the rocks and was overlooked by the Japs looking for us. I lay there until nine p.m.

doc_barta2.phrase: I passed out on the way and later came to and got ashore.

doc_coral.phrase: Balchus hit him on the head with a big piece of coral
